shaipe:project.shaipe:prompt:
tCreate a complete professional **vector brand identity for “secrets”**, an open-source, local-first secret manager and secret broker for developers and Linux desktops.
The visual identity should communicate: **security, privacy, developer tooling, local-first architecture, control, trust and interoperability.**
## Core logo symbol
Create a distinctive geometric symbol combining:
* A minimal **hexagonal padlock** * A simple rounded shackle * A clean geometric keyhole in the center * **Three electronic circuit traces** extending from the right side of the lock * A small circular connection node at the end of each trace * The lock and circuit traces must form one coherent symbol * Precise geometric construction * Strong symmetry * Rounded line caps and joins * Minimal and recognizable at very small sizes * No 3D effects * No shadows * No mockup effects * No unnecessary decorative elements
The symbol should work equally well as a Linux application icon, browser extension icon, system tray icon, favicon and developer-tool logo.
## Color system
Use a vibrant but restrained gradient progressing from:
* Green: **#45D66F** * Turquoise: **#18C7A5** * Blue: **#3498DB**
The gradient should feel modern and technical without looking like a generic AI or crypto logo.
The artwork must work on:
* white * light gray * dark gray * black
Do not put a background rectangle behind the logo.
Prefer transparent backgrounds.
## Wordmark
Create the lowercase wordmark:
**secrets**
Use a modern geometric sans-serif style similar in spirit to: **Inter, Geist, SF Pro Display or a similarly clean contemporary typeface.**
The wordmark should be lowercase, understated, modern and highly legible.
Use slightly tight letter spacing.
The wordmark should visually complement the geometric lock symbol rather than compete with it.
## Tagline
The brand tagline is:
**“Your secrets. Your control.”**
Keep the tagline separate from the primary logo. It should never be permanently incorporated into the logo mark.
---
# REQUIRED EXPORTABLE VARIANTS
Create and explicitly name each of the following variants as a separate, independently exportable vector asset.
### VARIANT 01 — `secrets-mark`
Symbol only.
Include:
* geometric lock * keyhole * three circuit traces * circular circuit nodes
Do NOT include the wordmark. Do NOT include the tagline.
This is the primary standalone brand mark.
---
### VARIANT 02 — `secrets-logo`
Horizontal primary logo.
Include:
* `secrets-mark` on the left * lowercase `secrets` wordmark on the right
Do NOT include the tagline.
This is the primary full logo.
---
### VARIANT 03 — `secrets-logo-tagline`
Horizontal brand lockup.
Include:
* `secrets-mark` * `secrets` wordmark * tagline: **“Your secrets. Your control.”**
The tagline should appear below the wordmark, visually subordinate to the project name.
This variant is intended for websites, README headers and presentations.
---
### VARIANT 04 — `secrets-wordmark`
Wordmark only.
Include only:
**secrets**
Do NOT include the symbol. Do NOT include the tagline.
---
### VARIANT 05 — `secrets-mark-monochrome`
Monochrome version of `secrets-mark`.
Use a single solid color. No gradient.
The design must remain identical to the primary mark.
Create it so that it works naturally on both light and dark backgrounds.
---
### VARIANT 06 — `secrets-logo-monochrome`
Monochrome version of `secrets-logo`.
Use:
* symbol * wordmark * one solid color
No gradient.
Do not alter the geometry or proportions of the primary logo.
---
### VARIANT 07 — `secrets-mark-dark`
Version of `secrets-mark` optimized for dark and black backgrounds.
Maintain the same geometry and visual identity, but adjust the treatment so the mark has excellent contrast and readability on:
* #000000 * #111111 * #1A1A1A
---
### VARIANT 08 — `secrets-mark-light`
Version of `secrets-mark` optimized for white and very light backgrounds.
Maintain the same geometry and visual identity, with excellent contrast on:
* #FFFFFF * #F5F5F5 * #EAEAEA
---
### VARIANT 09 — `secrets-favicon`
Compact icon derived from `secrets-mark`.
Optimize specifically for very small sizes such as:
16×16, 24×24, 32×32 and 48×48 pixels.
Simplify only details that become illegible at small sizes while preserving the recognizable lock + circuit identity.
No wordmark. No tagline.
---
### VARIANT 10 — `secrets-app-icon`
Square application icon based on `secrets-mark`.
The mark should be centered and optimized for Linux desktop application launchers and browser extensions.
Use a transparent background version AND a version with a simple solid background suitable for application icon systems.
Do not introduce additional symbols or decorations.
---
## Brand consistency requirements
All variants must use the **exact same underlying visual identity**.
Do not create different logo concepts for different variants.
The following must remain consistent across all variants:
* lock geometry * keyhole geometry * circuit traces * circuit nodes * proportions * gradient colors * wordmark typography * visual weight
The variants are adaptations of ONE logo system, not ten different logo proposals.
## Technical requirements
The logo part should look exactly like the inspiration (eg. a single continuous gradient, outlined not filled...).
Every variant must be created as a genuine editable **vector asset**.
Prefer:
* SVG paths * SVG shapes * editable text where appropriate * vector gradients
Do NOT use:
* raster images * embedded PNG/JPEG * screenshots * photorealistic rendering * mockups * textures * drop shadows * bitmap effects
Each required variant must be explicitly materialized and individually exportable under the exact names specified above.
The final result should look like a polished identity system for a serious open-source developer/security project rather than a generic cybersecurity company.
